responsibilities: Contributed to architectural design, project documentation, publications, client communication, and presentation preparation.
Supported cultural and museum-related projects, including the Bangladesh National Museum.
Assisted in the development of the Shilpacharya Zainul Abedin Gallery, engaging with exhibition environments, gallery experience, and visitor-oriented design.
Supported exhibition planning, coordination, installation, research, documentation, curatorial development, and visitor engagement in museum and gallery contexts.
Contributed to heritage, art, and architecture exhibitions with attention to interpretation, presentation, and public-facing experience.

responsibilities: Organized and coordinated a 10-day international heritage workshop supported by UNESCO, the Department of Archaeology Bangladesh, and the Bangladesh National Museum.
Managed lectures, archival exploration, museum gallery engagement, site visits, hands-on training activities, and multi-site program logistics.
Facilitated collaboration among international participants, heritage professionals, cultural institutions, and academic institutions.
